label: Synthetic person identifier
role_and_relationships: Identifier only; exclude from imputation models

label: Age at survey, years
role_and_relationships: Predicts employment, general health, vaccination and health impact

label: Sex
role_and_relationships: Potential donor/class variable; modest predictor in models

label: Broad ethnic group
permitted_values_or_range: White; Asian or Asian British; Black, Black British, Caribbean or African; Mixed or multiple ethnic groups; Other ethnic group
role_and_relationships: Potential donor/class variable; use cautiously and assess bias

label: Region of usual residence
permitted_values_or_range: North East; North West; Yorkshire and The Humber; East Midlands; West Midlands; East of England; London; South East; South West
role_and_relationships: Useful for hot-deck classes and geographic variation

label: Current economic activity
permitted_values_or_range: Employed; Unemployed; Student; Retired; Economically inactive
role_and_relationships: Strongly related to age and somewhat to health

label: Self-rated general health
permitted_values_or_range: Very good; Good; Fair; Bad; Very bad
role_and_relationships: Predicts symptom burden and activity limitation; related to age/employment

label: Fictional-pandemic vaccine doses
role_and_relationships: Related to age/health and inversely related to symptom burden

label: Days with respiratory symptoms in previous 28 days
role_and_relationships: Key numeric outcome; predicts activity-limited days

label: Days unable to undertake usual activities in previous 28 days
permitted_values_or_range: 0-28 and must not exceed respiratory symptom days
role_and_relationships: Strongly related to symptom days, general health and age; suitable for ratio/regression/PMM
